name: foreach_div_tensor
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_foreach_div.Tensor(...) -> Tensor[]. Applies foreach div between a Tensor list and one scalar Tensor; it returns a newly allocated Tensor list without aliasing self. The correctness suite covers contiguous and noncontiguous floating inputs, exact overload dispatch, list-output values or in-place storage preservation, and mismatched list lengths where applicable.
